column1: # Spanish (Castilian standard, the variety of the espeak-ng voice `es`): improved-mode gold set, test split.
# Written by hand before any improved-mode work on the language was measured on
# it; the dev/test split was fixed when the file was written. Test rows are
# scored once per change of the language and never used to adjust rules.
# Sources (standard descriptions and pronouncing dictionaries; no phonemizer):

#   Martínez-Celdrán, Fernández-Planas & Carrera-Sabaté (2003), "Castilian Spanish", Journal of the International Phonetic Association 33(2); Real Academia Española, Nueva gramática de la lengua española: Fonética y fonología (2011); Navarro Tomás, Manual de pronunciación española
# Notation: approximants β ð ɣ after vowels and most consonants; θ for c/z; x for j; ʎ or ʝ for ll (yeísmo accepted); nasal assimilation (ŋ ɱ); s voiced before a voiced consonant.
# check=ipa: segments must equal one expected form after notational
# normalisation (stress marks, tie bars, non-syllabic and syllabic marks
# removed; a long consonant written with ː counts as double); the primary
# stress must fall on the same vowel. Alternatives are separated by |.
